note.text: Real — the Administrative Services Organization (ASO) that administers CTDHP for Connecticut DSS (selected 2008). BeneCare facilitates administration: Plan-Net provider directory, referral receipt + coordination, prior-authorization / post-procedure review intake, and member services. It is NOT the claims payer and does not adjudicate 837D claims — those are adjudicated and paid by Gainwell (the DSS fiscal agent). The Plan-Net provider directory query in this use case is directed at the CTDHP/BeneCare network directory.
